_doc: P278 hand-authored evidence-package SAMPLE (SUPERVISED_EVAL). Source-grounded validation hypotheses from revert-lend src (read read-only). Demonstrates the 10-point readiness standard is REACHABLE (a complete package -> READY_FOR_POC_INTENT). These are VALIDATION hypotheses (evidence complete enough to attempt a PoC), NOT confirmed findings; no severity/reportability.

packages.source_refs: src/V3Vault.sol#L497-L544 transform(): transformerAllowList gate; nonfungiblePositionManager.approve(transformer, tokenId); (bool success,)=transformer.call(data); end-of-call ownerOf + _requireLoanIsHealthy
packages.mechanism_hypothesis: transform() approves a whitelisted transformer over the borrower's Uniswap-V3 position NFT and forwards attacker-supplied calldata via transformer.call(data); within that window the transformer holds NFT approval and executes arbitrary operations on the position, bounded only by the end-of-call ownerOf==vault and _requireLoanIsHealthy checks.
packages.root_cause: approval + arbitrary external call to a whitelisted transformer with caller-controlled `data`; the only post-conditions are owner-unchanged and loan-healthy, so any manipulation that preserves both is unconstrained.
packages.affected_state_vars: loans[tokenId].debtShares, position liquidity/fees in nonfungiblePositionManager, transformedTokenId reentrancy guard
packages.attacker_model: loan owner OR an address in transformApprovals[loanOwner][tokenId][caller] (an approved transform caller); no privileged role.
packages.attacker_controlled_inputs: transformer (any whitelisted), data (arbitrary calldata to that transformer), tokenId.
packages.victim_gainer: victim = loan owner / vault LPs if value is extracted from the position while keeping the loan healthy; gainer = attacker-approved caller.
packages.state_value_liveness_delta: position value (liquidity/fees) decreases by up to the slack between current and minimum-healthy collateral, extracted to the transformer-directed recipient within one transform call.
packages.invariant_expected: transform may only perform the intended single transformation and must leave the position no worse than minimum-healthy for the owner.
packages.invariant_broken: the only enforced bound is end-of-call health; value can be removed down to the health boundary and redirected, not restricted to the intended transformation.
packages.tx_sequence: 1) owner approves attacker via approveTransform (or attacker is owner); 2) attacker calls transform(tokenId, whitelistedTransformer, craftedData); 3) transformer.call(data) decreases position liquidity / routes fees; 4) end checks pass (owner==vault, loan still >= min health).
packages.terminality_or_amplification: repeatable each block while approval stands; amplifiable across multiple owned/approved positions.
packages.runner_up_mechanism: reentrancy via transformedTokenId guard (already blocked by the Reentrancy() check) — distinguished and refuted as the wrong mechanism.
packages.why_selected: coverage-routed EXTERNAL_INTEGRATION; arbitrary external call + approval is a classic over-trust surface.
packages.falsification_questions: Does _requireLoanIsHealthy use a conservative (post-extraction) valuation that prevents any extraction? Can the transformer move value to a non-owner recipient at all given the approve-then-revoke window?
packages.refutation_result: checked: end-of-call _requireLoanIsHealthy + ownerOf==vault re-collateralization bound the damage to the health-slack; the hypothesis therefore claims bounded extraction within slack, not unbounded theft — survives benign-design refutation as a value-leak-to-health-boundary claim.
packages.poc_assertion: after transform with a crafted transformer call, assert position liquidity/fees decreased and value landed at an attacker-chosen recipient while _requireLoanIsHealthy still passes (loan not liquidatable).
packages.unresolved_assumptions: depends on at least one whitelisted transformer exposing a value-moving operation callable with arbitrary `data`; bounded — does not carry the core control-point claim.

packages.source_refs: src/V3Vault.sol _convertToAssets(debtShares, exchangeRateX96, Math.Rounding.Up) in transform()/liquidate; debt rounding direction on conversion.
packages.mechanism_hypothesis: debt is converted with Rounding.Up while collateral/share credits round down elsewhere; repeated small operations could accrue rounding in the protocol's or borrower's favor depending on path.
packages.root_cause: asymmetric rounding direction between debt-shares->assets (up) and asset->shares (down) across the deposit/withdraw/liquidate paths.
packages.attacker_model: permissionless borrower/depositor performing many small deposit/withdraw or repay operations.
packages.attacker_controlled_inputs: operation amounts (chosen to maximize per-op rounding remainder), repetition count.
packages.victim_gainer: victim = other LPs / protocol reserve if dust accrues to the attacker; gainer = the looping account.
packages.state_value_liveness_delta: per-operation dust of <=1 share-unit; net delta = dust * repetitions.
packages.invariant_expected: share<->asset conversions conserve value up to <=1 unit per op and never let a round-trip net positive for the actor.
packages.invariant_broken: if a deposit-then-withdraw (or repay) round-trip nets the actor > input due to opposed rounding, conservation is violated.
packages.tx_sequence: 1) deposit A; 2) withdraw A; 3) compare shares/assets returned vs paid; 4) repeat to accumulate.
packages.terminality_or_amplification: dust-scale per op; amplifiable by repetition (gas-bounded).
packages.runner_up_mechanism: first-depositor share inflation (distinct mechanism) — checked separately.
packages.why_selected: coverage-routed SHARE_ROUNDING_PRECISION; opposed rounding is a known precision-leak family.
packages.falsification_questions: Does the round-trip actually net positive for the actor, or does every path round in the protocol's favor (so dust is benign)?
packages.refutation_result: checked: must demonstrate a concrete round-trip that nets the actor > input; if all paths round toward the protocol the candidate is BENIGN. PoC will decide.
packages.poc_assertion: assert a deposit->withdraw (or repay) round-trip returns strictly more assets/shares to the actor than paid in, accumulating over N repetitions.
packages.unresolved_assumptions: the existence of a value-positive round-trip is the claim under test; bounded by the PoC assertion itself.
